//lib-note: lib mirrors the app tsconfig: files reachable from the eval graph (db -> graph/session) legitimately use web APIs like fetch and need the DOM lib to typecheck.
//: Standalone build for the eval runner. The app's own tsconfig targets the Next.js bundler (which resolves extensionless relative imports for us); plain Node ESM does not, so evals are compiled to CommonJS in a temp dir and run from there. Keeps evals dependency-free and leaves app source untouched.
